visualCharacteristics.purpose: Filterable grid of people: portrait, name and role; each card opens a bio side panel
notes: Cream background; search input top-left filters the grid; 4-up grid of greyscale square portraits, name in large light type, gold role line, gold arrow.

The whole card is a button (pointer cursor, keyboard focusable) that opens a 560px cream (#f5f3ea) side panel from the right over a 75% black mask: square portrait, name (21px light), gold role, bio (16px/24px, #565759).

Panel closes with the 60px circular close button (white outline on the mask, 40px left of the panel; white disc top-right on mobile), Escape or a backdrop click; a Previous / Next bar pages through every person.

contentPattern.structure: optional first single-cell row = search placeholder text (enables the filter); then one row per person: cell 1 = portrait, cell 2 = name paragraph + role paragraph (+ optional bio link), cell 3 (optional) = bio (semantic HTML or plain text), hidden in the card and shown in the side panel
patterns: bio side panel dialog with prev/next
blockContent: 11 person cards (portrait, name, role, bio) with a search filter field above; clicking a card opens the bio panel

reuseGuidance: Use for people listings with portrait + name + role. Use cards-flip when the bio should be shown on the card back.
